recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. It completes the seed clarification against current ActorDefinition wording; handle the separate FHIR-50087 terminology move in its own workflow if needed.
issue_request: FHIR-43805 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 clarification asking which ActorDefinition definition was correct because the first resource description mentioned a human or application while the Resource Content description only mentioned an application. The Jira resolution pointed to FHIR-43646.
initial_application: No FHIR-43805-tagged source commit was found. FHIR-43646 was applied by commit 53dc7647943a1bff90d2177ccf6c2d070c8e75d5, changing the ActorDefinition root short to include a human or system, but the top-level StructureDefinition.description retained the older human/application text.
additional_context: FHIR-43469 later refined the same ActorDefinition alignment family after FHIR-44475 established broader actor-type terminology. The current root ActorDefinition definition describes a system, individual, non-system device, or collective. FHIR-50087 later changed ActorDefinition.type/category in source, but its Jira status is Resolved - change required and it was used only as background.
reconciliation: Updated source/actordefinition/structuredefinition-ActorDefinition.xml so StructureDefinition.description matches the current root ActorDefinition actor scope.
source_changes: source/actordefinition/structuredefinition-ActorDefinition.xml: changed the resource description from human/application wording to system, individual, non-system device, or collective wording aligned with the root definition.
